tools_helpful.evidence: Namespace mass-rewrite Windows.UI.Xaml -> Microsoft.UI.Xaml landed cleanly; final build SUCCEEDED and scored 100/100.

tool_limitations.limitation: Copies the UWP Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs verbatim into the WinUI 3 tree. SDK-style WinUI projects auto-generate assembly-level attributes (GenerateAssemblyInfo=true by default), so the copied AssemblyInfo.cs produces CS0579 'Duplicate assembly attribute' errors.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Exclude/neutralize UWP AssemblyInfo.cs (and other assembly-attribute-only files) during copy.

special_apis.special_handling: Device-gated; on a headless dev box these surface an 'Access denied.' status fallback. This is correct defensive UI and not a defect (confirmed pass in score).

errors_encountered.root_cause: UWP-era Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs was copied into the migrated tree and conflicts with the SDK-generated assembly attributes emitted by the WinUI 3 SDK-style project.
errors_encountered.fix: Delete the copied AssemblyInfo.cs (agent deleted it manually after diagnosing).

errors_encountered.root_cause: The dev-agent used header-only edits on copied UWP .cs files that replaced the top of each file but left the original body intact, duplicating every type/member. Multiple scenario files affected.
errors_encountered.fix: Agent overwrote each affected file completely (truncated the duplicated trailing body).

dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: many turns across several build cycles
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Edit that replaced a file header duplicated the body; the same edit pattern was repeated across many files before the agent switched to full-file overwrite.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Agent rewrote affected files wholesale via PowerShell overwrite.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Skill guidance to prefer full-file replacement (not header-only edits) when adapting copied UWP source, and to overwrite the whole file when a duplicate-definition flood appears.

dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: 1-2 turns after the duplicate-body flood cleared
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: UWP AssemblyInfo.cs copied into an SDK-style project that auto-generates the same attributes.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Bootstrap should not copy AssemblyInfo.cs (Tier-1); a MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md entry mapping CS0579 -> delete AssemblyInfo.cs (Tier-3) as backstop.
